        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = { which = bca_jr_cooldown_empty_treasure_gatherer_gestalt value <= 0 }
            }
            clear_variable = bca_jr_cooldown_empty_treasure_gatherer_gestalt
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = { which = bca_jr_cooldown_full_turtle_miner_gestalt value > 0 }
        }
        subtract_variable = { which = bca_jr_cooldown_full_turtle_miner_gestalt value = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = { which = bca_jr_cooldown_full_turtle_miner_gestalt value <= 0 }
            }
            clear_variable = bca_jr_cooldown_full_turtle_miner_gestalt
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = { which = bca_jr_cooldown_empty_turtle_miner_gestalt value > 0 }

                }

                    which = bca_jr_v_eff
                    value = bca_jr_v_size
                }
                multiply_variable = {
                    which = bca_jr_v_eff
                    value = value:bca_jr_f1_agri_drone
                }
                multiply_variable = {
                    which = bca_jr_v_eff
                    value = value:bca_jr_f2_agri_drone
                }

                colony = {
                    add_variable = {
                        which = bca_jr_acc_raw_agri_drone
                        value = prev.bca_jr_v_size
                    }
                    add_variable = {
                        which = bca_jr_acc_eff_agri_drone
                        value = prev.bca_jr_v_eff

                        value = modifier:job_agri_drone_add

                has_job_type = knight
                check_variable = { which = bca_jr_cooldown_full_knight value <= 0 }
            }
            every_job_pop_group = {
                limit = { pop_group_size > 1 }

                export_trigger_value_to_variable = {
                    trigger = pop_group_size
                    variable = bca_jr_v_size
                }

                set_variable = {
                    which = bca_jr_v_eff
                    value = bca_jr_v_size
                }
                multiply_variable = {
                    which = bca_jr_v_eff
                    value = value:bca_jr_f1_knight
                }
                multiply_variable = {
                    which = bca_jr_v_eff
                    value = value:bca_jr_f2_knight
                }

                colony = {
                    add_variable = {
                        which = bca_jr_acc_raw_knight
                        value = prev.bca_jr_v_size
                    }
                    add_variable = {
                        which = bca_jr_acc_eff_knight
                        value = prev.bca_jr_v_eff
                    }
                    # 累加后判断满/空，设冷却（只在计算实际发生时执行）
                    set_variable = {
                        which = bca_jr_tmp_slots
                        value = modifier:job_knight_add
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            check_variable_arithmetic = {
                                which = bca_jr_acc_raw_knight
                                value >= bca_jr_tmp_slots
                            }
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            which = bca_jr_cooldown_full_knight
                            value = 6
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
